Use active/problem-list timing and encounter diagnosis dates to distinguish current/recent conditions from historical diagnoses.
The fields can build a non-user denominator and clinical candidate pool after exposure users are excluded.
Apply literature-supported condition value sets and the conditions enriched among current users; do not infer benefit from correlation alone.

Resource optimization, utilization cost, LOS, readmissions, and formal patient-centered outcomes are not supported by this short request.
Mark those dimensions as data insufficient unless future pulls add claims/cost, inpatient/utilization, PROMs, or medication data.
